note: In the Green Falls area of Pachaug State Forest, Voluntown: wooded sites on a loop just north of Green Fall Pond, with a short trail to a swimming beach and a car-top launch on the pond. Two pets allowed per site. The surrounding forest is open to hunting. --Claude
